verdict.rationale: Microsoft Entra ID is a cloud identity service that processes customer directory data, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether that data is excluded from AI model training. The axis therefore applies, but no item in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, data-use commitment, or related privacy control. The docs cover only identity, provisioning, authentication, and Graph API features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
